ways.typed: Open /docs in a browser, expand POST /search, Try it out, paste the body, Execute

ways.about: The router describes its own API (OpenAPI) and serves Swagger UI on top of it. Every endpoint has named example bodies; Try it out sends a real request from the browser and shows the curl command, the response and how long it took. Good for exploring: nothing to install, and the examples are checked by tests/test_api_docs.py.

ways.about: A thin Python layer over HTTP for scripted, repeatable calls: it signs tokens for alice, bob or admin (--as), prints the request it sent and the response it got, colours them by outcome, and --pick pulls one value out of the answer. The demo guide is written in it. In code, the same call is http_search_fn(url, token) in src/agent/tools.py.

ways.about: The command line the assignment asks for (A1): one POST /search with the shipped fusion settings spelled out, then rank, score, doc id and a snippet per passage. It never touches an index; all the searching happens in the router and its shards.

ways.about: One question through the single agent. Before its LLM sees anything it asks the router's guardrails (POST /guardrails/check); then it searches, reads the snippets and may rewrite the query and search again, up to 3 steps. The LLM never talks to the router: the agent code does, with ordinary HTTP calls like the other three ways.
